require "json"
require "digest"
require "fileutils"
require "open3"
root, output, action = ARGV
root, output = [root, output].map { File.expand_path(_1) }
require File.join(root, "bench/request_pairs")
module ProspectiveCacheAA
  def summarize(rounds, **options)
    result = super(rounds, **options.merge(tolerance: 0.1))
    controls = options.fetch(:controls).to_h do |metric|
      low, high = result.fetch(:layers).fetch("off_b").fetch(metric).fetch(:delta_pct).fetch(:ci95)
      [metric, low >= -0.1 && high <= 0.1]
    end
    result[:aa] = {pass: controls.values.all?, metrics: controls, tolerance_pct: 0.1,
      zero_containment_required: false, rule: "both_intervals_wholly_within_plus_minus_0.1_percent"}
    result
  end
end
RequestPairs.singleton_class.prepend(ProspectiveCacheAA)
raise "one interpreter slot required" unless ENV["BENCH_JOBS"] == "1" && JitStability.mode == "interpreter"
raise "new output required; no retries" if File.exist?(output)
base = File.join(root, ".lowrail/lobsters-cache")
app = File.join(root, ".corpus/ruby-bench/benchmarks/lobsters")
seed = File.join(base, "seed")
worker = File.join(base, "ir-worker.rb")
artifact = File.join(base, "empty-ir")
revision = "42d3e5ade83922afc1ed39c632cc3c8ecee0dcd0"
sha, status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
changes, clean = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain")
raise "frozen source required" unless status.success? && clean.success? && sha.strip == revision && changes.empty?
raise "fixture hash changed" unless Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(seed, "primary.sqlite3")).hexdigest ==
  "d9817ef63aed4989d504d26e341b33d163448cb123f10981082718876227a820"
manifest = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(artifact, "manifest.json")))
raise "empty interpreter artifact required" unless manifest.fetch("units").empty? && manifest.fetch("files").empty? &&
  manifest.fetch("certification_jit") == "interpreter"
tool_root = "/tmp/lowrail-cache-valgrind-brk512"
tool = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(tool_root, "share/lowrail/valgrind.json")))
raise "brk512/source/patch pin required" unless tool.fetch("version") == "3.19.0" && tool.fetch("brk_reservation_mib") == 512 &&
  tool.fetch("patch_sha256") == Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(root, "bench/valgrind-brk.patch")).hexdigest &&

gem_paths, gem_status = Open3.capture2({"BUNDLE_GEMFILE" => gemfile}, RbConfig.ruby, "-S", "bundle", "show", "--paths")
raise "bundle pins unavailable" unless gem_status.success?

files = [__FILE__, worker, extension, RbConfig.ruby, File.join(artifact, "manifest.json"), File.join(seed, "primary.sqlite3"),
  File.join(tool_root, tool.fetch("tool")), File.join(tool_root, "bin/valgrind")]
files += Dir[File.join(root, "{bench,gem/lib,fixtures}/**/*")].select { File.file?(_1) }
files += Dir[File.join(app, "{app,config,db,lib}/**/*")].select { File.file?(_1) }
gem_paths.lines.map(&:strip).each { |path| files += Dir[File.join(path, "lib/**/*.{rb,so}")].select { File.file?(_1) } }
files = files.map { File.expand_path(_1) }.uniq.sort.to_h { [_1, Digest::SHA256.file(_1).hexdigest] }
pins = {root: root, revision: revision, seed: seed, files_sha256: files, tool: tool,
  routes: ["GET:/", "GET:/s/enr7ye"], rounds: 6, requests: 50, warmup: 50,
  floors: HeapWindows.floors, aa_rule: "both total/no-GC intervals wholly within ±0.1%; zero containment not required",
  retry: false, excluded: [], source_note: "Unchanged published prototype; benchmark-only wrapper, no app/config patches"}
pins_path = File.join(output, "pins.json")
File.write(pins_path, JSON.pretty_generate(pins))
File.chmod(0o444, pins_path)
env = ENV.keys.grep(/\A(?:LOWRAIL|RUBY_|BUNDLE_|RAILS_|RACK_ENV|BENCH_)/).to_h { [_1, nil] }.merge(
  "RAILS_ENV" => "production", "RACK_ENV" => "production", "BUNDLE_GEMFILE" => gemfile, "BUNDLE_FROZEN" => "true",
  "RUBYOPT" => "-rbundler/setup -I#{root}/gem/lib -rlowrail/setup", "BENCH_JIT" => "0", "BENCH_WARMUP" => "50",
  "LOWRAIL_SEALED" => "1", "LOWRAIL_ROOT" => app, "LOWRAIL_DIR" => artifact,
  "CACHE_COHORT_PINS" => pins_path, "CACHE_COHORT_PINS_SHA256" => Digest::SHA256.file(pins_path).hexdigest)
arms = %w[off_a off_b on].to_h { [_1, env.merge("LOWRAIL" => _1 == "on" ? "1" : "0")] }
FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(app, "tmp/cache"))
if action == "budget"
  arms.each do |name, settings|
    FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(app, "tmp/cache"))
    floors = HeapWindows.floors.each_with_index.to_h { |n, pool| ["RUBY_GC_HEAP_#{pool}_INIT_SLOTS", n.to_s] }
    ok = system(settings.merge(floors).merge("BENCH_CALLGRIND_EXTENSION" => extension, "LOWRAIL_STATS" => "1"),
      "valgrind", "--tool=none", RbConfig.ruby, *JitStability.flags("0"), worker, pins[:routes].join(","),
      chdir: app, out: File.join(output, "#{name}.log"), err: [:child, :out])
    raise "untimed heap/coverage budget failed: #{name}" unless ok
  end
  puts "UNTIMED_BUDGET_COMPLETE; no Callgrind counts"
  exit
end
raise "fixed historical floors required" unless HeapWindows.floors == [1_000_000, 250_000, 100_000, 20_000, 10_000]
metadata = {seed: 41231, rounds: 6, workers: {}, revision: revision,
  pins_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(pins_path).hexdigest, routes: pins[:routes]}
accepted = RequestPairs.heap_instructions(arms, app, output, pins[:routes].join(","), metadata, worker: worker, requests: 50)
samples_path = File.join(output, "samples.json")
data = JSON.parse(File.read(samples_path))
raise "finite worker/round count changed" unless data.fetch("workers").size == 18 && data.fetch("samples").size == 6
data.fetch("workers").each do |name, record|
  lines = File.readlines(File.join(output, "#{name}.log"))
  before = JSON.parse(lines.find { _1.start_with?("CACHE_COHORT_PIN ") }.delete_prefix("CACHE_COHORT_PIN "))
  after = JSON.parse(lines.find { _1.start_with?("CACHE_COHORT_FINAL ") }.delete_prefix("CACHE_COHORT_FINAL "))
  raise "pin certificate changed" unless [before, after].all? { _1.fetch("revision") == revision && _1.fetch("pins_sha256") == metadata[:pins_sha256] }
  record["source_certificate"] = {"before" => before, "after" => after}
end
responses = data.fetch("workers").values.map { _1.fetch("source_certificate").fetch("after").fetch("exact_after") }
exact = responses.map { |routes| routes.transform_values { |seeds| seeds.transform_values { _1.reject { |key, _| key == "evidence" } } } }.uniq.size == 1
per_route = pins[:routes].to_h do |route|
  rows = data.fetch("samples").map do |round|
    round.to_h { |arm, value| [arm, value.fetch("operations").fetch(route)] }
  end
  [route, RequestPairs.summarize(rows, seed: 41231, tolerance: 0.1,
    metrics: %w[instructions_total instructions_no_gc], controls: %w[instructions_total instructions_no_gc])]
end
files.each { |file, expected| raise "source changed: #{file}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest == expected }
File.write(samples_path, JSON.pretty_generate(data))
accepted &&= exact && per_route.values.all? { _1.fetch(:aa).fetch(:pass) }
File.write(File.join(output, "result.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(accepted: accepted, exact: exact,
  revision: revision, workers: 18, rounds: 6, retry: false, excluded: [], per_route: per_route))
puts "CACHE_IR_COHORT #{accepted ? 'accepted' : 'REJECTED; retained'}"
exit(accepted ? 0 : 2)

# Untimed provenance and fixture setup around the unchanged HeapWindows seam.
require "json"
require "digest"
require "open3"
pins_path = ENV.fetch("CACHE_COHORT_PINS")
pins_sha = Digest::SHA256.file(pins_path).hexdigest
raise "pins changed" unless pins_sha == ENV.fetch("CACHE_COHORT_PINS_SHA256")
pins = JSON.parse(File.read(pins_path))
root = pins.fetch("root")
check = -> {
  sha, status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  changes, clean = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain")
  raise "source revision/cleanliness changed" unless status.success? && clean.success? &&
    sha.strip == pins.fetch("revision") && changes.empty?
  pins.fetch("files_sha256").each do |file, expected|
    raise "source changed: #{file}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest == expected
  end
  {revision: sha.strip, clean: true, pins_sha256: pins_sha, pid: Process.pid, ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION}
}
puts "CACHE_COHORT_PIN #{JSON.generate(check.call)}"
$stdout.flush
require File.join(root, "bench/jit_stability")
require File.expand_path("config/application", Dir.pwd)
Rails.application.config.yjit = false
require File.expand_path("config/environment", Dir.pwd)
require File.join(root, "bench/experiments/lobsters_cache_screen")
Exploration.install(config: {"app" => Dir.pwd, "exploration_only" => true},
  state: pins.fetch("seed"), arm: ENV.fetch("LOWRAIL") == "1" ? "on" : "off_a")
require "rack/mock"
require ENV.fetch("BENCH_CALLGRIND_EXTENSION")
Rails.application.eager_load!
Rails.logger.level = :warn
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = nil
JitStability.assert_mode!
raise "interpreter only" unless JitStability.actual == "interpreter"
raise "shipped in-memory fixture required" unless ActiveRecord::Base.connection_db_config.database == ":memory:"
routes = ARGV.fetch(0).split(",")
session = Rack::MockRequest.new(Rails.application)
headers = {"HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on", "HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID" => "lowrail-lobsters-sealed"}
requests = Integer(ENV.fetch("BENCH_REQUESTS", "50"))
workload = ->(n, route) {
  verb, path = route.split(":", 2)
  n.times do
    response = session.request(verb, path, headers)
    raise "HTTP #{response.status}" unless response.status == 200
  end
}
exact = -> {
  routes.to_h do |route|
    verb, path = route.split(":", 2)
    [route, [0, 1].to_h do |seed|
      response, evidence = Exploration.validation_request(route: "#{verb} #{path}", seed: seed,
        request: -> { session.request(verb, path, headers) })
      raise "exact companion rejected" unless response.status == 200 && evidence.fetch("passed")
      [seed, {status: response.status, body_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(response.body),
        headers_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(JSON.generate(response.headers.to_h.sort.to_h)), evidence: evidence}]
    end]
  end
}
routes.each { workload.call(Integer(ENV.fetch("BENCH_WARMUP", "50")), _1) }
before_exact = exact.call
coverage = []
if ENV["LOWRAIL_STATS"] == "1"
  # Only tool=none companions. Copies are outside the actual client requests.
  LowrailCallgrindBench.singleton_class.prepend(Module.new do
    define_method(:start) do |*args|
      coverage << {before: LowrailCachePlan.counters.dup}
      super(*args)
    end
    define_method(:finish) do
      result = super()
      coverage.last[:after] = LowrailCachePlan.counters.dup
      result
    end
  end)
end
windows = HeapWindows.windows(requests, routes)
anchors = HeapWindows.run(windows, settle: -> { routes.each { workload.call(1, _1) } }, &workload)
puts "LOWRAIL_BENCH #{JSON.generate(**JitStability.state, ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION, windows: windows,
  operations: true, heap_anchors: anchors, heap_page_targets: HeapWindows.page_targets,
  compiled_iseqs: 0, jit_warmup: nil, request_settle: true)}"
after_exact = exact.call
raise "plans missing" if ENV["LOWRAIL"] == "1" && LowrailCachePlan.plans.size != routes.size
puts "CACHE_COHORT_FINAL #{JSON.generate(check.call.merge(exact_before: before_exact, exact_after: after_exact,
  plans: LowrailCachePlan.plans.size, coverage: coverage))}"
# The evidence intentionally retains the real clock reads before substitution.
# Compare every response field, not those diagnostic timestamps.
observables = ->(rows) { rows.transform_values { |seeds| seeds.transform_values { _1.reject { |key, _| key == :evidence } } } }
raise "response changed across windows" unless observables.call(before_exact) == observables.call(after_exact)
